name: Hanoi

quotes.text: -if you desperately need an ambulance, call 115. But ambulances are slow in Hanoi. The city is not built for speed. Also the front desk of your hotel may be able to help, especially with translation.
-if you can, get yourself to a major private hospital using Grab. I like Vinmec, but Tam Anh and Hanoi French Hospital are good options.

Bun cha is one of the dishes that instantly brings Hanoi to mind.

The smoky grilled pork, soft rice noodles, fresh herbs and dipping sauce are familiar to anyone exploring Vietnamese cuisine.

But how did bun cha become such an important part of Hanoi's food culture?
hanoifusion.com/bun-cha-hano...

If you want to see real Hanoi and you are in the tourist quarter, somehow get up at 5am and go down to Hoan Kiem Lake. You would think it was mid-day on Saturday for how busy it is. But nope, it's any day of the week. People will be running, dancing, and doing aerobics like the 80s never ended.
